request.raw_text: Design cylindrical bearing on the flat end of the part (the one without fillet). Create another 7 instances of this design and rotate them around the bearing axis.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The straight, non-filleted end of the existing elongated part and the existing bearing geometry
areas_to_change.location: At the flat end opposite the rounded/filleted end, nominally centered across the strip width
areas_to_change.description: Add a hollow cylindrical bearing or bearing boss at the square end of the strip, preferably matching the existing bearing's form and with its axis normal to the broad face of the strip.

areas_to_change.action: Create 7 additional instances using a circular rotational pattern
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The completed seed design and the cylindrical bearing axis
areas_to_change.location: Distributed around the specified bearing axis
areas_to_change.description: Pattern the seed design seven additional times about the bearing axis, producing eight total instances. In the absence of a stated angle, infer a full 360-degree pattern with equal 45-degree spacing.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Retain the strip thickness, width, length, and planar faces except where the new bearing is joined.
Preserve its current outer profile and fillet geometry.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Existing hollow cylindrical bearing and its blended base
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its bore, outer cylindrical wall, axis, height, and blended connection unless it is intentionally included in the patterned seed.
Do not remove or reshape existing features; additions and patterned instances should retain the seed geometry.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: A cylindrical hollow bearing is added at the non-filleted end of the strip. The completed design is repeated seven more times in a circular array, nominally yielding eight equally spaced instances around a common bearing axis.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The new bearing provides an additional cylindrical pivot or shaft-support interface, while the rotational array creates a repeated radial assembly around a shared axis.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: All patterned instances remain geometrically identical and angularly indexed about the bearing axis; with a full circular pattern they are separated by 45 degrees.

ambiguities.description: It is unclear whether the new bearing should copy the existing bearing exactly or merely be a generic cylindrical bearing.
candidate_interpretations: Duplicate the existing hollow cylindrical bearing, including its rounded blended base.
Create a new cylindrical sleeve bearing with unspecified dimensions.
Create a solid cylindrical boss rather than a hollow sleeve.

ambiguities.description: The phrase 'on the flat end' does not uniquely define the mounting face or bearing-axis direction.
candidate_interpretations: Place the bearing on the broad top face near the square end, with its axis parallel to the existing bearing axis.
Attach the bearing directly to the terminal end face, with its axis along the strip length.

ambiguities.description: The object represented by 'this design' is not explicit.
candidate_interpretations: Pattern the entire completed part, including the strip and both bearing features.
Pattern only the newly created bearing feature.
Pattern a subassembly consisting of the strip and the new bearing.

ambiguities.description: Rotating a concentric bearing about its own axis would create fully overlapping copies if only the bearing is patterned.
candidate_interpretations: Use the bearing axis to circularly pattern the entire eccentric strip design.
Use a different bearing axis, such as the existing bearing axis, to distribute the new bearing features.
Create rotated but coincident bearing instances, although this would not materially change the geometry.

ambiguities.description: The total pattern angle and spacing are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Create eight total instances equally spaced over 360 degrees at 45-degree increments.
Create seven additional instances over a user-defined partial angular range.
Apply a specified incremental rotation angle that must be provided separately.
